mediatorDescription: Finds statements practising Christians and non-religious conservatives can both sign, without either side adopting the other’s reasons.
mediatorNote: Mediator-authored modified wordings and shared planks. Natural camp boards stay as the camps wrote them. Scripture-in-every-language and colorblind merit are unique planks and are not in this cluster.
nudgeReason: Mediator wording that keeps your reasons while naming the overlapping claim.

parents.title: Christianity
parents.summary: Practising Christians, in their own words: abortion, provision for the poor, sex and marriage, and making Scripture available. A mediator (Hardhat #8) publishes modified wordings toward secular conservatives; those modified texts are not these planks.
parents.modifiedSummary: Mediator wording of practising-Christian planks that still imply the shared abortion, markets, and LGBT claims. Not an official revision of the Christianity cause.

parents.title: Secular conservatism
parents.summary: Secular conservatives, in their own words: abortion, markets, sex and marriage, and colorblind merit. Modified wordings live on the mediator cluster, not on this roster.
parents.modifiedSummary: Mediator wording of secular-conservative planks that still imply the shared abortion, markets, and LGBT claims. Not an official revision of the secular conservatism cause.

bridge.title: Christian / secular shared ground
bridge.summary: Bridge cause whose featured planks are implied by each modified wording. Unique camp planks (Scripture; colorblind merit) are not here.

projects.name: New-language Scripture draft
projects.description: Pay two translators to finish a first draft of the Gospels in a language that currently has no published Scripture.

projects.name: Parish winter warming centre
projects.description: Keep a church hall open overnight through the cold months: cots, a kitchen, and a volunteer rota neighbouring congregations can share.

projects.name: Campus chaplaincy at State U
projects.description: Fund a chaplain and a student hospitality budget at a large secular university.

projects.name: Crisis pregnancy help, not an abortuary
projects.description: A clinic that offers ultrasounds, material help, and genuine alternatives to abortion. It does not treat abortion as health care.

projects.name: Elective-abortion restriction brief
projects.description: A short public brief arguing that elective abortion is not health care and that life-of-the-mother exceptions are not a license for an undo button.

projects.name: Trade apprenticeship match fund
projects.description: Match private donations that put people into paid trades training instead of expanding a welfare caseload.

projects.name: Local charity effectiveness audit
projects.description: Publish outcome numbers for city charities that actually get people into work, without arguing about theology.

projects.name: Keep schools and libraries off the pipeline
projects.description: Parent-education and school-board work against Drag Queen Story Hour, exhibitionist Pride events around kids, and treating gender-distressed minors as a medical-transition pipeline.

projects.name: Parish marriage-prep course
projects.description: A church-run course on Christian marriage. Not a civil-policy project.

projects.name: Colorblind admissions amicus
projects.description: Legal research arguing public universities should not award or penalize applicants for ancestry.
